name: Moshimo Ossan ga Auction Site de Shiriatta Kyonyuu Gyaru o Rakusatsu Shitara
original_name: もしもオッサンがオークションサイトで知り合った巨乳ギャルを落札したら
source:
Did you know you can buy dates online?
I did it.

Of course, it's cheaper than going to a shop.

That's not why I did it, though.

I clicked on the "fashion" category and a bunch of sexy thumbnails let me browse my gals.
